summary: Fetch one public still-image origin and render its exact multi-position rank filmstrip.

parity.note: This is the fused transport form of media.fetch followed by media.filmstrip for a known still-image origin. It streams the same response into a temporary file and calls the same filmstrip handler with the same positions, measured-duration probe, crop and PNG sink; only the intermediate scheduler step and local binding disappear. A dead origin or unreadable image leaves the optional strip absent.

url.description: A credential-free public still-image origin. The caller has already classified the suffix as an image; this op has no video or editorial vocabulary.

positions.description: Filmstrip geometry, passed unchanged to media.filmstrip. A still measures duration zero and therefore produces its one frame padded to the requested number of cells.

fit.description: The same cell geometry enum accepted by media.filmstrip.
